name: a migration drops a column the login response returns

change.title: Drop the legacy session token from the login response
change.description: The login response carried both session_token and session_id. session_token goes away and clients read session_id. A migration drops the session_token column from the sessions table.

name: two typos in the onboarding copy

change.title: Fix two typos in the onboarding copy
change.description: Two spelling mistakes in the onboarding screens and one in the README. The wording around them stays as it is and the screens keep their behaviour.

name: the retry loop in the export worker, behind the same signature

change.title: Back off exponentially in the export worker
change.description: The export worker retried on a fixed one second delay and now backs off exponentially with a cap of thirty seconds. The retry function keeps its signature, every caller stays as it is, and a call that succeeds today still succeeds. The number of attempts stays at five.

name: the default request timeout goes from ten seconds to thirty

change.title: Raise the default request timeout to thirty seconds
change.description: The HTTP client shipped a default timeout of ten seconds and now defaults to thirty. Callers that set their own timeout keep it. A slow call that used to give up after ten seconds holds the connection for thirty.
